text_block_list.name: Spectating Умамусумэs
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's starting…! 
What was it, "Shirabyōshi"? 
Sounds kinda cool～!

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text: This tale tells of one who lives by the dance. My master stands peerless in our age. Though I, by side, merely crude apprentice, within me dedication yet resides, to that selfsame pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text: My disciple, my cherished disciple. The bell of practice beckons. Come hither.

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text: Hoo! Ya! Haaa!

text_block_list.name: Цурумару Цуёси
text_block_list.text: Ah, what disappointment, indescribable disappointment. Is this all the worth of the disciple to our age's preeminent dancer?

text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо
text_block_list.text: Timidity abounds in her steps. Behold, even her left hand moves in slovenly manner!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, a disappointment indeed, how pitiful!

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text: Argh! Cease this tumult, cease! …… Nevertheless, my steps… Ugh… I shall attempt once more!

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
(While teased and advised by the butterflies, 
the Shirabyōshi devotes herself to training. 
Then, a peculiar traveling performer arrives…)

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
Хару Урара
text_block_list.text: Now then, a dance I shall present you. Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
text_block_list.text: Wahahaa, such joy, such delight! Dancing is indeed a joyful art!

text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
text_block_list.text: Though I may not emulate my master's style, to bestow such merriment is a tribute to their grandeur. Ah, such delight～♪

text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
text_block_list.text: (I had to change the script a bit since it was tough, but… my performance was praised for being uniquely me!)

text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone watching seems to be enjoying it too! 
It's all smiles, just like a race. Such joy～ Such delight～♪)

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
(Impressed by the traveling performer's sword dance, the 
Shirabyōshi deepens her understanding of dance, continuing 
her training until she masters the most intricate techniques.)

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
(The twin butterflies, having witnessed her progress, reveal 
their true identities. They were messengers of the three 
goddesses ——)

text_block_list.name: Цурумару Цуёси
text_block_list.text: Through unwavering dedication to the inheritance of your master's skills, our recognition you have swayed. Therefore, we bestow upon you our blessing.

text_block_list.name: Цурумару Цуёси
text_block_list.text:
(That desire to chase, surpass, and carry on the legacy of 
someone you admire… Surely, that's a feeling everyone holds. 
To all those emotions, we send our blessings ——)

text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо
text_block_list.text: This is the will of the three pillars. Accept this gift.

text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо
text_block_list.text:
(The feelings that Prez put into this offering will be carried 
on by none other than me. And I will surpass her!)

text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо
text_block_list.text:
(—— Watch me, "Emperor" Симболи Рудольф! 
As the "Sovereign", I will create the greatest stage ever!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Entrusted to gods supreme, may our ancient path flourish, lasting for ages hereafter ——

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
(Thus, the Shirabyōshi, blessed by the butterflies, 
becomes known as the best dancer of her generation, 
spreading her arts far and wide ——)

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text: O mighty and revered three pillars, witness my dance till its end. Draw near, draw near, heed the resolve set in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text:
(—— Madam King, please watch this "first-class" dance, 
entrusted to me by you…!)

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text: My essence carries my mentor's legacy and the solemnity of the pillars. I am the vessel of ancestral wisdom, pledging to prolong their esteemed heritage.

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text: Proud and noble spirits, swaying gracefully, swayed by flame. Rage throughout heaven and earth, burn bright, lead us to prosperity. I am chronicler of tale, I am successor of legacy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator Умамусумэ A
text_block_list.text:
—— That "Votive Stage Play" was incredible. It really 
fired me up… makes me want to see my senior again.

text_block_list.name: Spectator Умамусумэ B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the senior who inspired you to come to Академия Тайсен～? 
Haha, I can relate to that.

text_block_list.name: Spectator Умамусумэ C
text_block_list.text:
—— Umm! I'm definitely going to win the next race. 
The race you won before… so, please come watch.

text_block_list.name: Spectator Умамусумэ D
text_block_list.text: …… Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: All Together
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so pumped! 
Definitely the best performance ever♪

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
I agree. It really turned out to be a great show. 
We couldn't have done it without all of you working 
hard despite the time constraints.

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text: More than anything… Ms. Kawakami, you ——

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Madam King that 
I could pull off the leading role!!

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text: —— Huh.

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text:
I've watched it over and over again! The video of Madam King's 
Shirabyōshi dance!! It's so graceful, elegant, dignified, yet 
powerful and beautiful……!

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text:
It's the determination I had to follow in Madam King's footsteps, 
to be someone who carries on her legacy… that drove me to 
give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text:
So it's all thanks to you, Madam King! 
You truly are my biggest inspiration!!

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text: —— Ms. Kawakami……

text_block_list.name: Цурумару Цуёси
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it!! Watching past performances, like the 
president's role as butterfly, really fired me up! I set it 
as my goal to surpass it!

text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's what motivated me to work hard and get this far! 
Me too… I want to say a big thanks to Prez too.

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
…… Hehe. Honestly… I'm the one 
who should be saying thank you.

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Ms. Rudolf feels the same about you two. 
Taking over from her and creating such an impressive stage.

text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you think so…? I hope that's the case…

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text: And… Ms. Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, once again. For accepting 
the role… and fulfilling my vision.

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text:
—— ! 
Uh, ehehehehe… I'm incredibly honored… ehehe…

text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
text_block_list.text: —— Ah, look at the fireworks!!

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
(They may rise unsteadily at first, but they bloom 
magnificently in an instant… For those of us watching, 
it's nothing but surprises…)
—— A few days after the Festival of Illustrious Equines.

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text: Hmhmm～ Hummm～♪

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
—— Oh, Ms. Kawakami. 
…… How long are you planning to keep that on?

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text:
Madam King! Ehehe, I absolutely adore this ribbon! 
It's truly a treasure among treasures!!

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
…… I'm glad you like it, but…… Seeing you so happy 
with it every day is a bit embarrassing……

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! I-I'm so sorry… um… 
Should I take it off…?

text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
text_block_list.text:
—— Oh, don't make that face!! 
…… Wear it as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe… I'll treasure this ribbon filled with 
Madam King's feelings, forever……!
